crossRefs.note: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.
The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.
Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah…
After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him…

people.name: Arah
people.line: A Jewish leader whose daughter married Tobiah's son.

people.name: Berechiah
people.line: Israelite who helped repair Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Jehohanan
people.line: Father-in-law of Tobiah, an opponent of Nehemiah

people.name: Meshullam
people.line: Helped repair the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah.

people.name: daughter_of_Meshullam
people.line: Married Jehohanan, son of Tobiah the Ammonite

people.name: daughter_of_Shecaniah
people.line: Married to one of Tobiah's sons

translations.web: For there were many in Judah sworn to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.
translations.bsb: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him, since he was a son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translations.kjv: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
translations.asv: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah to wife.
